title: BG graph disappear upon sensor start (Libre bluetooth)
symptom: After starting a new sensor, BG graph disappeared on main screen and history. BG is displayed with trend arrow, history populates with statistics, but BG dots are not displayed. DB backup restore and reboot phone did not help.
cause: The issue was caused by the 'Show Libre Trend' setting being enabled. Enabling it hides all dots, disabling it brings them back.
fix: Disable the 'Show Libre Trend' setting. The user found that enabling Libre Trend on the master hides all dots, disabling it they come back.
evidence_quote: Enabling Libre Trend on the master hides all dots, disabling it they come back.
